```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Build the table header
cat('<table class="table" style="width:100%;">')
cat('<tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr>')

# 3. Loop through and force RAW HTML
for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  # Clean the path
  repo_path <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  
  # Image URL (using the 200 OK link we verified)
  img_url <- paste0("[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", repo_path, "@main/Capture.PNG")
  
  # Demo URL (rebuilt to avoid 404)
  user <- gsub("/.*", "", repo_path)
  repo <- gsub(".*/", "", repo_path)
  demo_url <- paste0("https://", user, ".github.io/", repo, "/")
  
  # WRITE RAW HTML ROWS
  cat('<tr>')
  cat(paste0('<td><img src="', img_url, '" width="250" style="display:block;"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><strong>', dt$title[i], '</strong></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Interactive Demo</a><br><a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source Code</a></td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</table>')
